operators.name: gelu_forward
semantics: Applies GELU activation element-wise, matching reference F.gelu(x) with default approximate='none'.
Output shape equals input shape; dtype float32; operation performed on CUDA tensor.

operators.name: linear_forward
semantics: Computes linear transformation: output = x @ weight.T + bias, matching reference self.linear(x) with bias=True.
Input x is viewed as a 2D matrix of shape [512*1000, 128], GEMM with weight transposed to [128, 256], then bias broadcast added to each row.
Output shape [512, 1000, 256]; dtype float32; operation on CUDA using cuBLAS sgemm and bias addition.
Apply GELU activation function element-wise to input tensor x of shape [512, 1000, 128].
Output preserves shape [512, 1000, 128], dtype float32, CUDA device.
Linear layer with in_features=128, out_features=256, bias=True applied to input [512, 1000, 128].
Output shape [512, 1000, 256], dtype float32, CUDA device.
Return the final tensor of shape [512, 1000, 256].
